About ▾
Phase 1 — Level-1 optimal superposition: Kabsch/Umeyama best-fit rotation + translation, all-atom and heavy-atom RMSD, ready-to-run mort.py arguments (−r column-major, −t in bohr), and transformed-Mobile XYZ export. Ghosts are excluded from the fit. The reflection guard keeps det(R)=+1 by default; enabling Allow reflection reports a mirror image instead.

All coordinates internal in Å. HDF5 read with a self-contained pure-JS reader (offline).
